name: AWA Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Held by Dream King for roughly four months before he dropped it to Marvelous Mike at the federation's own pay-per-view, Slaughter in the Hell; no document survives naming when or where Dream King himself won it.

name: Asian Championship
epitaph: Changed hands after a three-month reign on the promotion's own Battle Royal pay-per-view.

name: Light Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Retained by disqualification on the promotion's own Battle Royal pay-per-view after an ally's interference.

name: Hardcore Championship
epitaph: Changed hands in a brawl that spilled into a restaurant and a fishing pool on the promotion's own Battle Royal pay-per-view.

name: Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Held throughout the promotion's own Battle Royal pay-per-view without being defended there.
